protocol: PROTOCOL.md § 6 bis (v1.3): written after seeing E2 and E3, before this run

pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

manifest.experiment: E2 bis, the partner trained for the pair (protocol section 6 bis, exploratory)

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.z_H: person H: plus network, mu = 1, half A (same seeds as E2)
keys.z_M: log-odds of each machine on its own (not the sum), shape (3, N), rows in the order of `machines`
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames
manifest.machine_training_frame: a ~ N(0, 2), independent of the class

machines.M0: cross-entropy on half B, as M_0 of E2 (same seed)
machines.Mpair: binary cross-entropy of the summed log-odds (out1 - out0) + z_H, z_H from frozen H (eval mode, bf16) on the same augmented and framed presentation, no gradient, weight one, no standardisation
machines.Mframe: as Mpair, but the machine sees the framed image with its interior set to zero (normalised units), in training and in test; H sees the whole image

manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.torch_seeds: as E2: crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<H|M>') & 0x7fffffff; the three machines share seed, initialisation, batch order, crops, flips and frames. With cudnn autotuning the runs are not bitwise reproducible: H and M0 are re-trained, close to but not identical with E2's
manifest.test_and_validation_frames: the same eps as E2: numpy default_rng(crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<test|val>-a')), a = sqrt(2) * eps

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

settings.bootstrap_weight: chosen again in each resample on 13 weights

B1.rule: in every unit: Mpair's d_a interval above zero, Mframe's containing zero, and the slope of both machines' cue on a opposite in sign to H's

B2.rule: phi(H, Mpair) - phi(H, M0) with its interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

B3.rule: Mpair alone less sensitive than M0 and (H, Mpair) more sensitive than (H, M0), both intervals excluding zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

B4.rule: tuned turing of (H, Mframe) with its interval above 1 in every seed in >= 3 tasks of 5, and median tuned / (1/sin phi) in [0.9, 1.1]

B5.rule: median tuned turing of (H, Mpair) / Tu_app from k and phi in [0.9, 1.1] (Tu_app: maximum over w >= 0)
